name: Docker
author: Majkelll
description: Everything you need for Docker in the bar, and nothing you don't: start, stop, restart, pause and remove containers, grouped by compose project with whole-project start/stop/restart and a one-click edit of the compose files or their folder in Files, view logs or open a shell, and watch live CPU/RAM per container and in total. No privileges asked for, nothing written to disk.

barWidget.description: Container list grouped by compose project, with start/stop/restart per project or per container, compose-file and project-folder opening, logs, shell, and live CPU/RAM.

schema.label: Group by compose project
schema.description: Collapse containers under their compose project, with start, stop and restart for the whole project. Off lists every container on its own, as before.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the container list is refreshed while the popup is open. Closed, it backs off to 30 seconds.

schema.label: CPU/RAM refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often CPU and memory are sampled while the popup is open. Runs on its own slower timer, and not at all while closed, because docker stats waits about two seconds for every sample regardless of how many containers exist.

schema.label: Graceful stop timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long docker may spend on a clean shutdown before it kills the container.
